title: Cover Rust and JavaScript registration identity parity for sourceOwner requests
outcome: The existing host Rust and launcher JavaScript registration identity implementations are tested against one shared sourceOwner-bearing request, preserving exact cross-language request correlation and unchanged legacy identities before consumer cutover.
acceptance: A shared conformance request containing all sourceOwner fields is evaluated by the actual Rust host and JavaScript launcher identity implementations, and both produce the same canonical identity/digest; fixture provenance and normalization rules are explicit without duplicating production judgment.

The same suites retain an absent-sourceOwner legacy control and discriminate identity changes when an owner pin field changes; no registration wire change, request replay weakening, hardcoded stored record id, source predicate or new execution gate is introduced.
